text.en:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Keanggotaan
Suruhanjaya Perkhidmatan Pendidikan 1990.

2. . Bilangan anggota lain Suruhanjaya Perkhidmatan Pendidikan tidaklah
boleh melebihi dua belas orang.

Diperbuat pada 16hb Mei 1990.
(PM. (S) 11334/1 Jilid 6; PN. (PU?) 171/XVL.)

Dengan Titah Perintah,

Daro' Seri AHMAD Sari BIN ABDUL HAMID,
' Setiausaha Jemaah Menteri

FEDERAL CONSTITUTION
CONSTITUTION OF THE EDUCATION SERVICE COMMISSION Order 1990

In exercise of the powers conferred by Clause (2) of Article 141A of the
Federal Constitution, the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following
order:

1, This Order may be cited as the Constitution of the Education
Service Commission Order 1990.

2. Thenumber ofthe othermembers of the Education Service Commission
shall not exceed twelve.

Made the 16th May 1990.
[PM. (S) 11334/1 Jilid 6; PN. (PU?) 171/XVI.]

By Command,

Dato' Suri AHMAD Sari BIN ABDUL Hamp,
Secretary to the Cabinet
